caption: The video captures a fire already burning inside a dark fireplace, seen through a fixed arched opening with a horizontal glowing log bed across the bottom. Two flame clusters rise from this bed, both vigorously stretching upward and bending into hook-like curls against the dark upper space, the right generally the taller and broader of the pair. Throughout the excerpt the flames continuously flicker, split, merge, and reshape themselves, their tongues lengthening and shortening without ever leaving the firebed. The left cluster leans and deforms, occasionally tilting toward the center and at times sending up a tongue as high as the right, while the right tends to keep the greater overall intensity. The central log glows and shifts in brightness but stays fixed in place, with no translation of the fuel visible. The surrounding brickwork and the lower frame bar hold their fixed positions. A few tiny bright specks appear intermittently in the upper-left darkness, drifting faintly like sparks or reflections. The combustion continues through the last frame, neither starting nor finishing within this excerpt.
